text: 之前关于卖淫的问题，我曾写过一个回答，但是这个回答仍然集中于较为传统的性产业，而随着互联网时代的发展性产业也出现了变化。
en: Previously, on the question of prostitution, I wrote an answer, but that answer still focused on the more traditional sex industry, whereas with the development of the internet age the sex industry has also changed.

text: 此前我一朋友拿到了一堆福利姬的盒，让我给她们分析分析，我当时没绷住，不敢要（拒绝开盒，从我做起）。
en: Earlier, a friend of mine got hold of a batch of welfare girls' 'files' and asked me to analyse them; I couldn't keep a straight face at the time and didn't dare take them (say no to doxxing, starting with me).

text: 但是我还是听他聊了一聊他所了解的一些状况（个人信息我没要，只听他聊了个大概），并结合我自己看查阅资料获得的信息，也确实又有了一些新的收获。
en: But I still listened to him talk about some of the situation as he understood it (I didn't take any personal information, only listened to the gist of what he said), and combined with the information I had gained from my own reading and research, I did come away with some new insights.

text: 先说说从传统娼妓到网络色情的共性。
en: First, let us speak of the commonalities running from traditional prostitutes to internet pornography.

text: 其一是，依然延续了传统娼妓的学历高层化和阶级分化趋势。
en: The first is that it still continues the traditional prostitutes' trend towards higher educational credentials and class differentiation.

text: 这也是他从福利姬信息中得出的最直观感受。
en: This was also the most immediate impression he formed from the welfare girls' information.

text: 早在2013年也有学者在上海调研上绘制过图表，可供参考。
en: As early as 2013, scholars also drew up charts from field research in Shanghai, which may serve as a reference.

text: 其二是，无论是福利姬还是传统娼妓，往往自愿认同而进入行业的少，相当一部分是因为经济压力或者被威逼利诱后进入行业，最终同样因为经济原因留在行业之中。
en: The second is that, whether welfare girls or traditional prostitutes, few enter the industry of their own volition and with acceptance of it; a considerable portion enter because of economic pressure or after being coerced and enticed, and ultimately remain in the industry for the same economic reasons.

text: 值得注意的是，福利姬只是网络色情的一个分支，网络色情的形式演化的非常多样，这里顺带讲一讲“家族长模式”。
en: It is worth noting that welfare girls are only one branch of internet pornography; the forms of internet pornography have evolved in a very diverse way, and here I will take the chance to speak of the 'family-head model'.

text: “家族长模式”是指负责招募主播提供给直播平台的人。
en: The 'family-head model' refers to those responsible for recruiting streamers to supply to live-streaming platforms.

text: 家族长是平台与主播之间的联系枢纽，平常会负责结算主播的直播收入，按照平台的规则管理主播，与古代的家族长相比完全不同。
en: The family head is the link between the platform and the streamers; ordinarily they settle the streamers' live-streaming income and manage the streamers according to the platform's rules—quite different from the family heads of ancient times.

text: 而一些不法分子为牟取暴利选择与色情直播平台合作，招募纠集色情主播组成家族在平台进行网络色情直播，并按照一定的分配比例与色情直播平台、主播分成获利。
en: And some lawbreakers, in order to reap huge profits, choose to cooperate with pornographic live-streaming platforms, recruiting and gathering pornographic streamers into families to conduct internet pornographic live streams on the platforms, and sharing the profits with the pornographic live-streaming platforms and streamers according to a certain distribution ratio.

text: ——张明晗《网络色情直播犯罪的治理对策—以家族长为视角》
en: —Minghan Zhang, 'Governance Countermeasures against Crimes of Internet Pornographic Live Streaming—from the Perspective of the Family Head'

text: “家族长模式”是一种规避权力机关治理的方式，不过该文作者给出这些娼妓如何进入行业的案例总结同样很有价值。
en: The 'family-head model' is a way of evading the governance of the authorities, but the case summaries the author gives of how these prostitutes enter the industry are likewise of great value.

text: 家族长的牟利方式主要是从色情主播的直播收入中抽取提成，为了牟取非法利益，他们会通过各种途径大肆招募主播。
en: The family head's way of making money is mainly to take a cut from the pornographic streamers' live-streaming income; in order to seek illegal gains, they recruit streamers aggressively through various channels.

text: 笔者以“色情直播”“网络直播”“淫秽表演”为关键词，截止到 2020 年共在裁判文书网收集到 148 份判决书，其中有 72 份文书写明家族长的招募方式。
en: Using 'pornographic live streaming', 'internet live streaming' and 'obscene performance' as keywords, the author collected a total of 148 verdict documents from the Judgment Documents website up to 2020, of which 72 documents specified the family heads' recruitment methods.

text: 根据判决书显示，家族长招募色情主播的方式主要有三种：第一种是在各种直播平台物色主播，家族长会主动接触人气一般的主播，通过刷礼物获得好感取得主播联系方式，用高薪诱惑主播加入色情直播平台；第二种是家族长拉拢亲人、朋友加入色情直播；第三种是家族长通过微信、QQ、陌陌等社交软件发布招募主播广告。
en: According to the verdicts, the family heads' methods of recruiting pornographic streamers mainly fall into three types: the first is to scout for streamers on various live-streaming platforms; the family head will take the initiative to approach streamers of average popularity, gain their favour by sending gifts to obtain the streamer's contact details, and lure the streamer into joining the pornographic live-streaming platform with the promise of high pay; the second is that the family head draws relatives and friends into the pornographic live streaming; the third is that the family head posts advertisements recruiting streamers through social software such as WeChat, QQ and Momo.

text: 此外家族长还会以艺术公司、文化传媒等名义对外招募主播，诱骗主播签合同并采用预收大量押金、索要高额违约金、发放高利贷等方式控制招募的主播进行色情表演。
en: In addition, family heads also recruit streamers externally under the guise of art companies, cultural media and the like, enticing streamers to sign contracts and then controlling the recruited streamers into pornographic performances by means such as collecting large deposits in advance, demanding high breach-of-contract penalties, and issuing usurious loans.

text: ——张明晗《网络色情直播犯罪的治理对策—以家族长为视角》
en: —Minghan Zhang, 'Governance Countermeasures against Crimes of Internet Pornographic Live Streaming—from the Perspective of the Family Head'

text: 甚至还有犯罪者通过逼迫的方式让已脱离行业的女性重新进入行业。
en: There are even criminals who, through coercion, force women who have already left the industry to re-enter it.

text: 一些犯罪团伙看到组织、容留妇女卖淫可以迅速敛财、获取暴利，不惜以身试法、铤而走险，用胁迫、暴力等手段强迫女性卖淫，甚至把女性拐骗、挟持到境外进行卖淫活动。
en: Seeing that organising and harbouring women's prostitution can rapidly amass wealth and yield huge profits, some criminal gangs stop at nothing to test the law and take desperate risks, forcing women into prostitution through coercion, violence and other means, and even abducting and holding women to take them abroad for prostitution activities.

text: 2018 年 2 月，W县李某甲、李某乙及满某( 男，15 岁) 等黑恶势力成员，以“卖淫还欠款”、将“卖淫一事发布微信朋友圈、告知家人”等手段相威胁，强迫陈某( 女，17岁) 、王某( 女，14 岁) 注册微信和陌陌帐号联系嫖客，分别在上海、合肥、昆山等地进行卖淫，所得嫖资由李某甲、李某乙支配。
en: In February 2018, members of a gangland evil force in County W—Li A, Li B and Man (male, 15)—using threats such as 'prostitute to repay the debt' and 'posting the prostitution on WeChat Moments and telling the family', forced Chen (female, 17) and Wang (female, 14) to register WeChat and Momo accounts to contact clients, and to engage in prostitution in places such as Shanghai, Hefei and Kunshan; the resulting prostitution money was controlled by Li A and Li B.

text: 该案中，犯罪嫌疑人最大的只有 21 岁，最小的满某尚不到负刑事责任的年龄，而受害人最小的只有 14 岁。
en: In this case, the oldest suspect was only 21, the youngest, Man, had not yet reached the age of criminal responsibility, and the youngest victim was only 14.

text: ——孙明锋《网络卖淫嫖娼违法犯罪的现状分析与治理对策》
en: —Mingfeng Sun, 'Analysis of the Current State of and Governance Countermeasures against Crimes of Internet Prostitution and Whoring'

text: 其三，除了上述的极端个例，整体来看，互联网时代下的娼妓或者所谓福利姬依然同过去一样具备“道德经济学”的优势，娼妓或者福利姬人身依附性弱，独立性较强，在同平台和嫖客的三元关系中并不处于弱势。
en: Thirdly, apart from the extreme individual cases mentioned above, overall, prostitutes or so-called welfare girls in the internet age still possess the advantages of a 'moral economy' just as in the past; prostitutes or welfare girls have weak personal dependency and stronger independence, and are not in a weak position in the tripartite relationship with the platform and the clients.

text: 在网络招嫖案件中不难看出，组织者对卖淫者的人身和精神上的强制性管束开始逐渐淡化，取而代之的是类似公司对员工的管理模式和调度方式。
en: In cases of internet prostitution solicitation it is not hard to see that the organisers' physical and mental coercive control over the prostitutes is gradually fading, replaced by a management model and dispatch method similar to that of a company over its employees.

text: 如果暂且忽略卖淫嫖娼活动的违法性，单纯将其作为劳动的一种，那么卖淫组织的头目就是用工者，而卖淫者则是提供劳动的工人。
en: If we temporarily set aside the illegality of prostitution and whoring activities and treat them simply as a kind of labour, then the head of the prostitution organisation is the employer, and the prostitute is the worker providing the labour.

text: 从组织者角度来说，组织者“招募”卖淫者，使其在自己的安排下开展卖淫活动，并从卖淫活动中牟取暴利是最大的犯罪目的。
en: From the organiser's perspective, the organiser 'recruits' prostitutes, enables them to carry out prostitution activities under their own arrangements, and seeks huge profits from the prostitution activities—this is the greatest criminal purpose.

text: 从卖淫者角度来说，在竞争日趋激烈、管控日益严苛的市场环境下，为追求经济效益的最大化和风险成本的最小化，自愿接受组织者的调度与安排，开展卖淫活动，最大限度的赚取利益。
en: From the prostitute's perspective, in a market environment of increasingly fierce competition and ever stricter control, in pursuit of maximising economic benefit and minimising risk cost, they voluntarily accept the organiser's dispatch and arrangements, carry out prostitution activities, and earn profit to the greatest extent.

text: 组织者和卖淫者在共同的经济利益刺激下，形成了“雇佣者”与“被雇佣者”的“双赢”，自然不需要像传统卖淫产业中通过对卖淫人员进行人身自由或施加精神压力来实现管理、控制的目的。
en: Stimulated by their common economic interest, the organiser and the prostitute form a 'win–win' between 'employer' and 'employee', and naturally there is no need, as in the traditional prostitution industry, to achieve the purpose of management and control by restricting the prostitute's personal freedom or applying mental pressure.

text: ——唐敏芳 徐思诗《新型网络组织卖淫案件实务研究——以吴某组织卖淫案为例》
en: —Mingfang Tang and Sishi Xu, 'Practical Research on New-Type Cases of Internet Organised Prostitution—Taking the Case of Wu's Organised Prostitution as an Example'

text: 其四，无论是一般的娼妓还是福利姬大部分人都不认同自己所处的行业，存在精神困境。
en: Fourthly, whether ordinary prostitutes or welfare girls, most do not identify with the industry they are in, and suffer from a spiritual predicament.

text: 在我之前所了解的案例中，就有不少娼妓存在各种各样的精神问题，甚至有自残和厌男恐男的现象。
en: Among the cases I had previously learned of, not a few prostitutes had various mental problems, even self-harm and manifestations of misandry and fear of men.

text: 而我这位朋友通过观察这些福利姬，也发现无论这些福利姬的所谓政治光谱是“日子人”、“小粉红”和“目田”，都或多或少接受了女权主义，同样也存在厌男恐男的现象。
en: And this friend of mine, through observing these welfare girls, also found that regardless of whether these welfare girls' so-called political spectrum is 'day-to-day folk', 'little pinks' or 'liberal', they have all more or less accepted feminism, and likewise exhibit manifestations of misandry and fear of men.

en: From this angle, supporting the legalisation of prostitution is conducive to cultivating feminists (certainly).

text: 但反过来讲，这些女性走向女权主义恰恰也在呈现其内心的创伤。
en: But conversely, these women's turn to feminism precisely also reveals the trauma within them.

text: 娼妓或者福利姬的政治化可能是当今互联网时代区别于过去的一大特点。
en: The politicisation of prostitutes or welfare girls may be a major characteristic distinguishing the present internet age from the past.

text: 除此以外，互联网色情产业的去中心化与秘密化的特点给晶格也带来了不小的麻烦。
en: Apart from this, the decentralised and secretive characteristics of the internet pornography industry have also brought no small trouble to the police.

text: 比如，我之前在公共厕所曾看到上门按摩服务的广告，这类所谓上门服务不仅方便暗箱操作，平台还可以脱责，在未来极有可能成为晶哥的重点关注对象。
en: For example, I previously saw advertisements for door-to-door massage services in a public toilet; such so-called door-to-door services not only facilitate under-the-table dealings, but the platform can also evade responsibility, and are highly likely to become a key focus for the police in future.

text: 不过，我更为好奇的是，如今的色情产业是否形成了一套流水线化再生产体系。
en: However, what I am more curious about is whether today's pornography industry has formed an assembly-line style reproduction system.

text: 但是考虑到有的福利姬不单单是做线上，恐怕光靠P图是没办法在行业混下去的。
en: But considering that some welfare girls don't only work online, I'm afraid relying on Photoshop alone won't let them get by in the industry.

text: 因此我当时直接推测这些姑娘可能是做了医美塑形，即便有经济压力也可以通过“医美贷”作为启动资金，随后进入行业“周转”。
en: So at the time I directly surmised that these girls may have had medical cosmetic sculpting done; even under economic pressure, they could use a 'medical-beauty loan' as start-up capital, and then enter the industry to 'turn over' funds.

text: 偿还本金和利息后就可以盈利。
en: After repaying the principal and interest, they can make a profit.

text: 这种“再生产模式”是否真实存在还缺乏田野调查的实证。
en: Whether this 'reproduction model' truly exists still lacks empirical evidence from fieldwork.

text: 但即便考虑到各种风险因素，这依然是一条很可行的“批量生产色情商品的流水线”。
en: But even taking various risk factors into account, this is still a highly feasible 'assembly line for the mass production of pornographic goods'.

text: 这恐怕是当今社会最极致的一种“物化”和“商品化”。
en: This is perhaps the most extreme form of 'objectification' and 'commodification' in today's society.

text: 可以这样讲，卖淫已经合了“笑贫不笑娼”的资本主义律法。
en: One could put it this way: prostitution has already conformed to the capitalist law of 'scorning the poor, not the prostitute'.
